_note: Design-system adherence rules, vendored from the EmmaDev Design System.
Two things are adapted for this repo: the import patterns point at
@/components/design-system/* instead of the upstream bare paths, and a few
DOM passthrough props (onClick, disabled, id) are added to the prop
allowlists because the vendored components spread ...rest onto the element.
The selectors are esquery and are applied by ESLint (eslint.adherence.config.mjs);

patterns.message: Import design-system components from '@/components/design-system', not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().
Font not provided by the design system. Available: Varela Round, JetBrains Mono.
<BlobPortrait> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, alt, size, ring.
<Button> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: variant, size, disabled, fullWidth, href, iconLeft, iconRight, children.
<Button> variant must be one of 'solid' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'gradient'.
<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<CursorTrail> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: count, dotSize, colors, follow.
<ExperienceCard> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: org, role, period, points, stack.
<GradientFrame> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: radius, inset, speed, children.
<GradientText> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: as, animate, speed, children.
<IconButton> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: label, size, glyph, children.
<MediaCarousel> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: images, alt, interval, fade, radius.
<NavBar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: items, activeHref, brand, right, onToggle.
<NavLink> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: href, active, children.
<NavPanel> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open, items, activeHref, onClose, footer.
<NavToggle> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: open.
<ProjectRow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: title, description, media, stack, flip, index.
<ResumePreview> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: src, href, width, height, label.
<Reveal> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: from, delay, duration, blur, once, as.
<Reveal> from must be one of 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right' | 'none'.
<ScrollTopArrow> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: href, assetBase, size, visible.
<SectionHeading> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: eyebrow, align, rule, children.
<SectionHeading> align must be one of 'left' | 'center'.
<SocialIconLink> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: network, href, size, assetBase, label.
<SocialIconLink> network must be one of 'github' | 'linkedin'.
<TagChip> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, interactive, children.
<TagChip> tone must be one of 'neutral' | 'accent'.
